field Message as string optional

state Open initial
state Closed terminal

event Start initial
event Enqueue(Item as string notempty)
event Report
event Finish

on Start
    -> set Message = "start"

from Open on Enqueue
    -> enqueue ClaimQueue Enqueue.Item
    -> no transition

from Open on Report
    -> set Message = "Queue depth: {ClaimQueue.count}"
    -> no transition

from Open on Finish
    -> transition Closed
